value.rationale: Source explicitly identifies the unknown critical KGSM momentum and expected Euclidean norm as research questions. The full sharp threshold on all invertible diagonal linear systems and arbitrarily unequal induced row probabilities provides a natural exact baseline; smoothing changes the stability region, and signed expectation can decay while mean-squared error grows. A meaningful solver-design boundary, not a trivial normalization or fabricated generalization.
